name: Fly
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You touch a creature and grant it the ability to fly, up to its Speed. Roll Lore to determine any additional effects.

When the spell ends, if the creature is in flight, it falls to the ground.
successes:
✨: The creature's Speed increases by 10 ft.

🌞: The creature's Speed increases by 20 ft and the spell lasts for 10 minutes without concentration.

💀: Whenever the creature attempts to fly, they fly in a random direction determined by the GM, then roll a d8. On a 1, the spell ends.
